## Notes

Free Lives, published by Devolver Digital; Windows, Android, iOS 2023-03-28 (mobile via Netflix Games), Linux and macOS 2023-10, Switch 2023-12; began as a Ludum Dare 45 entry (October 2019); turbines on stone power toxin scrubbers; pumps refill rivers; points per restored tile; biomes attract animals; recycle buildings and leave.
